decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting is a specialized option with high uncertainty but potential high-value contracts, so it is worth keeping open while its prospects remain unresolved.
The spring-balanced desk lamp is peripheral to the firm's application-specific lighting solutions and lacks strong strategic fit, making its option value too limited to justify continued commitment.
General interior lighting luminaires are core to the firm's business and align with energy-efficient building solutions, so this option is central and will be maintained.
As the flagship pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics, it is central to the firm's human-centric lighting direction and will be retained as a key strategic option.
The marine HMI searchlight is a niche, energy-intensive product that does not align with the firm's shift toward LED and human-centric solutions, so its option value is low.
This generic marine searchlight is redundant with other marine options and offers little additional value, so resources are better freed for more promising projects.
